places.note: no House membership needed.; Day pass covers the lounge, coffee, and snacks (price unconfirmed), Mon–Fri 8am–8pm.

places.name: The New Work Project
places.label: DAY PASS · ~$40
places.note: Design-led Williamsburg loft with gallery-style desks and carefully detailed studios.; Day pass about $40 (price unconfirmed; email hello@thenewworkproject.com for a gallery-desk pass), Mon–Tue 9:30am–5pm, Wed–Fri 9am–5pm.

places.name: Bibliotheque
places.label: CAFÉ · LAPTOP-OK 10–5
places.note: Café, wine bar, and working bookstore lined with real books.; Official policy is laptops 10am–5pm only (open Sun–Thu 10am–10pm, Fri–Sat to 11pm); good for deep work, but the room echoes, so not for calls.

places.name: Remi Flowers & Coffee (43rd St)
places.label: CAFÉ · LAPTOP-OK
places.note: Lush, plant-filled, greenhouse-like flower shop and café that Infatuation lists for getting work done.; Wi-Fi, outlets, and hours unconfirmed; it's a block from the Ford Foundation garden.

places.name: David Rubenstein Atrium at Lincoln Center
places.label: FREE · ATRIUM
places.note: Tall public atrium with living plant walls and skylights opposite Lincoln Center.; Free, Mon–Fri 8am–10pm, Sat–Sun 9am–10pm, first-come seating; Wi-Fi unconfirmed and free shows can make it loud.

places.name: Silence Please
places.label: CAFÉ · LAPTOP-OK
places.note: Hidden tea and listening room: buzz in at an unmarked Bowery door and climb an industrial staircase to Togo couches and neon gramophones.; Infatuation says you can stay for hours with Wi-Fi once you've ordered (about $16), but outlets are f

places.name: Workville — Broadway
places.label: DAY PASS · ~$49
places.note: Luxury-hotel-style floor with custom furniture, black-and-white tile, and exposed brick near Herald Square.; Day pass about $49 (price unconfirmed), business hours, meeting rooms from about $75/hr.

places.name: The Yard — Greenpoint
places.label: DAY PASS · ~$30–35
places.note: Bright coworking with mid-century-modern furniture near McCarren Park.; Open-desk day pass about $30–35 (price unconfirmed), 9:30am–5:30pm, with kitchen, lounge, and Wi-Fi.

places.name: Primary — 26 Broadway
places.label: DAY PASS · ~$30–60
places.note: Wellness-minded, plant-filled space in the Standard Oil Building by Bowling Green.; Day pass about $30–60 (price unconfirmed); no official site found.

places.name: No More Cafe
places.label: ZERO-PROOF BAR · $$
places.note: Fully alcohol-free cocktail bar and all-day cafe; house signatures like Island Echo (lime, ginger, cacao nib) and smoky Agave Phantom.; East Village, roughly noon-midnight (weekday 5pm openings announced from Dec 1).

places.name: Soft Bar + Cafe
places.label: ZERO-PROOF BAR · $$
places.note: Greenpoint all-day alcohol-free cafe and bar from Carl Radke; 'soft cocktails' like Golden Hour (grape, elderflower, NA Champagne) and Pear Pressure, plus matcha and functional drinks.; Bar from 2pm (Tue-Sun hours posted).

places.name: Spirited Away
places.label: NA BOTTLE SHOP · $$
places.note: in-store tastings (e.g.; Saicho sparkling tea, Nov 25 2026) but no bar.; Daily noon-8pm.

places.name: Mockingbird
places.label: ZERO-PROOF BAR · $$
places.note: Candlelit Park Slope bar where every bottle is NA; Blackberry Momentum (ginger, yerba mate, mint) and Eden's Bite (roasted-pepper NA tequila, serrano).; Cocktail service Thu-Sun evenings; daytime cafe Mon-Wed.

places.name: Lord's
places.label: NA COCKTAILS · RESTAURANT · $$$
places.note: British-leaning restaurant with a full NA aperitif section: Blood Orange Spritz, a Ghia sour and a Saffron White Negroni.; Reserve on Resy.

places.label: NA COCKTAILS · RESTAURANT · $$$
places.note: Modern-Asian dining room under MoMA whose mocktails match the cocktails: Godai (house-made 'whisky' tea, licorice root) and Lime Lite (Pentire, lime cordial, orange blossom).

places.name: Bar Calico
places.address: 23 Lexington Ave, 2nd fl, New York, NY 10010
places.label: NA COCKTAILS · BAR · $$
places.note: Prickly Pair (Ritual agave, almond syrup, soda) and an NA margarita with cactus brine.

places.name: Sofreh
places.label: NA DRINKS · PERSIAN RESTAURANT · $$
places.note: Persian restaurant in Prospect Heights with house sharbats (mint-cucumber, sour cherry, lemon-saffron) and Persian black tea.; the rose doogh is yogurt.

places.name: Spygold
places.label: NA COCKTAILS · BAR · $$$
places.note: Mon-Sat from 5pm.

places.name: Pranakhon
places.label: NA COCKTAILS · THAI RESTAURANT · $$
places.note: Big, theatrical Bangkok-style Thai near Union Square with mocktails that aren't just NA riffs: Ma Na (salted plum, Amass Riverine) and Manee (jackfruit 'creamsicle').; Good for groups.

places.name: The Up & Up
places.label: NA COCKTAILS · BAR · $$
places.note: Village basement cocktail bar with serious zero-proof builds: Hold, Please (watermelon shrub, Tajin) and Zuzu's Petals (ginger, habanero, rose water).; Reserve on weekends.

places.name: Tamarind Tribeca
places.label: NA COCKTAILS · INDIAN RESTAURANT · $$$
places.note: Upscale Indian restaurant with juice-forward NA drinks: Tamarind Punch (pomegranate, pineapple, mango) and Tikha Ras (jalapeno, mango, passion fruit).

places.name: 12 Matcha
places.label: MATCHA BAR · $$
places.note: NoHo flagship pouring first-harvest ceremonial matcha; Daily 8:30am-5pm.

places.name: Kettl Matcha Sen Mon Ten
places.label: MATCHA BAR · $$
places.note: Kettl's tea bar is nearby at 70 Greenpoint Ave.

places.name: Té Company
places.label: TEA HOUSE · $$
places.note: Tiny 13-seat tearoom for Taiwanese oolongs brewed at the table, plus seasonal refreshments and the Pineapple Linzer.; Tue-Fri noon-6pm, weekends from 11am.

places.name: Fong On
places.label: SOY MILK & TOFU SHOP · $
places.note: Family tofu shop since 1933, revived on Division St: fresh tofu-grade soy milk and grass jelly.

places.name: Brooklyn Farmacy & Soda Fountain
places.label: SODA FOUNTAIN · $
places.note: Restored 1920s apothecary in Carroll Gardens pulling egg creams, phosphates and sodas from the fountain.

places.name: Sugarcane Daddy
places.label: SUGARCANE JUICE · $
places.note: Chinatown takeout window pressing fresh sugarcane juice to order, with fruit add-ins (around $7-8 for a large).

places.name: Los Tacos No. 1 (Chelsea Market)
places.label: AGUAS FRESCAS · $
places.note: skip the horchata if strict.

places.name: High & Dry
places.label: ZERO-PROOF BAR · $
places.note: Alcohol-free cafe-bar under the J/M/Z tracks on the Bushwick/Bed-Stuy line: kombucha on tap, butterfly-pea lemonade, coffee-lemonade.; Open noon-midnight, cheap ($6-8).

places.name: Kosmic Community Anti Bar
places.label: ZERO-PROOF BAR · $
places.note: East Village sober 'anti bar' with zero-proof drinks, botanical teas, matcha, coffee, kava and NA beer, plus DJ nights and movie nights.; Open late on weekends; kava is psychoactive, so skip if avoiding it.; Heads-up: kava is a mild sedativ

places.name: Taning Lemon Tea
places.label: LEMON TEA · FLUSHING · $
places.note: Hand-pounded Guangdong-style lemon tea with real lemon and zest; Frangipani Jasmine Lemon Tea is the one.; takeout only, crowds at peak.

places.name: Lexington Candy Shop
places.label: SODA FOUNTAIN · $
places.note: Last original Upper East Side luncheonette, still mixing fountain Coke by hand from syrup and seltzer, plus hand-mixed malts at the counter.; malts are not.
